source_refs.note: Topic 15.1 (Methods of Separation of Mixtures), printed page 324.

blocks.text: The components of a mixture can be separated by physical methods: filtration, crystallization, simple distillation, fractional distillation and paper chromatography.
Which technique suits each mixture: petroleum and water; NaCl and NaNO3; activated charcoal and sodium chloride; methanol, ethanol and propanol?
